messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Feb 24, 2025, Sudipti Priyadarsinee via AMBER wrote:
>I submitted a minimization run nut i got the following errors in slurm file
>and output file.
>
>*Slurm file with errors:Program received signal SIGSEGV: Segmentation fault
This message just says the job failed.  We would need more information about
what you are trying to do, which program you are running, what is actually
in the mdout file, and so on.  Please set maxcyc=10 and ntpr=1 when you run
these.
....dac
